target: fatal accidents involving Boeing commercial jets

evidence.scope: global commercial aviation under IATA methodology
evidence.observation: IATA explicitly counts missing MH370 as an aviation accident and explicitly excludes MH17 as an unlawful act. Its annual review reports 12 fatal accidents, three involving jets.

evidence.source_title: 2014 Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents
evidence.scope: worldwide commercial jet fleet under documented Boeing rules
evidence.observation: Boeing lists three fatal accidents in its 2014 table: Eastern SkyJets 737-300 with one external fatality, Swiftair MD-83 with 116 onboard fatalities and Indonesia AirAsia A320 with 162 onboard fatalities. The same edition explicitly excludes MH370 at that publication date and excludes hostile-action events by definition.
evidence.use: annual jet mapping, Boeing membership mapping for non-boundary events, and source-taxonomy evidence

evidence.publisher: Malaysia Ministry of Transport, MH370 Safety Investigation Team
evidence.observation: Scheduled passenger flight MH370, Boeing 777-2H6ER 9M-MRO, serial 28420, 239 persons; aircraft remains missing after extensive search with recovered debris consistent with MH370.

evidence.authority_role: Annex 13-led safety investigation authority for MH17
evidence.observation: Boeing 777-200 9M-MRD, serial 28411; Buk surface-to-air missile warhead caused in-flight breakup; all 298 occupants killed.

evidence.publisher: Gabon Ministry of Transport / national aviation investigation reporting
evidence.scope: event-level contemporaneous report quoting ministry communiqué
evidence.observation: A6-ESR, Boeing 737 operating Senegal Airlines DN055 with 137 occupants, fatally struck a person during landing at Libreville.
evidence.use: event-level state evidence for included Boeing candidate

open_items: Resolve by preregistered prospective rule, not post-hoc outcome preference, whether missing-aircraft events such as MH370 belong to the frozen target.
Resolve the hostile/unlawful-action boundary consistently across MH17, PS752 and any comparable event.
Do not infer that Boeing/IATA publication-specific exclusions automatically define the frozen BSFM target.

completeness_assessment.reason: The 2014 fatal-jet universe and relevant Boeing aircraft are mapped, with competent-investigation evidence for MH370/MH17 and state evidence for the Libreville external-fatality event. However the frozen target does not settle missing-aircraft and hostile/unlawful-action boundaries, so Boeing target membership and target taxonomy cannot pass.
